method_note: Two things are kept apart in every finding. QURRA root assignment = the root QURRA assigns to the lemma (qurra_value.root). Source indexing = the root/family/heading under which a classical source happens to discuss the word (source_indexing, source_entry_heading). They are not necessarily identical, and source indexing is evidence only: it never replaces the QURRA root. Quadriliteral roots (رباعي, for example ز ل ز ل) are roots in their own right and are never reduced to a related triliteral.

gloss.en: Allah — the One God / god; deity; one worshipped
